notes: expectedSha1Hex is deliberately wrong (all zeros) against the real SHA1 of 'plugin-jar-contents-v1' (d1434be5db668fbf3bfcc1887e9d9354e29428ef, from the sibling successful-stage fixture). stage_download verifies the checksum against the in-memory bytes before writing anything, so a mismatch never creates a temp file to begin with — tempFileExists is false not because a temp file was cleaned up, but because one was never staged. The pre-existing destination (a prior, different plugin.jar) is asserted unchanged, matching msc2-engineering.md §7's 'moved into active use only after validation.'
